text:
Lina: Thimble (our tortoise) found the mini shopping cart in the breakroom and will not stop pushing it around until someone loads it with snacks. photo attached :turtle: :shopping_cart:
Sam: No way, share the pic pls 😭🧡
Naveen: Wait we have a mini cart? When did we get that?
Zoe: I made it out of a model kit last week for the desk diorama, didn’t expect it to become a mobility aid for Thimble 😂
Lina: Here’s a quick clip: https://imgur.com/example (tiny 7s video). He’s very deliberate about the route he takes.
Sam: That tortoise has better errand discipline than me. Also the little wheel squeak is iconic :joy::sweat_smile:
Naveen: We should add a tiny name tag: "Thimble’s Errands". Also, is he allowed in the kitchen zone?
ops-bot: Note: Pets are allowed in common areas at discretion of host and must not access open food prep surfaces. Please keep animals on leash/carrier in the kitchen.
Lina: Yep keeping him on the checkered mat while near the coffee station. No food handling, promise.
Zoe: Can we make tiny checklists for Thimble? like: 1) Push cart 2) Inspect crumbs 3) Nap beside potted fern
Sam: I volunteer to be his official cart pusher. Will bring micro carrots tomorrow. :carrot:
Lina: Deal. Micro carrots for Thimble and maybe a micro apron? :turtle::apron:
Naveen: Official poll: should Thimble have a Slack emoji? :eyes:
Sam: 100% yes
Zoe: yes pls.
Lina: I’ll ask design for a tiny cart+turtle emoji.
ops-bot: FYI: Next health inspection on Friday — please ensure all shared food areas are free of animal access during the inspection window (09:00–11:00).
Sam: ok noted. Thimble’s cart is strictly decorative during inspection hours 😅
Lina: Thx all — photo dump incoming in the thread replies :)
